The curriculum

8 modules. All practical. All startup-relevant.

Real situations your managers face every day — not textbook theory.

01
Set Clear Goals & Expectations
Set OKRs that drive performance — make winning crystal clear from Day 1.
02
Hire & Onboard Top Talent
Interview for culture fit, make the right hire, get them productive in 30 days.
03
Delegate Tasks Effectively
Let go without losing control — build accountability, stop being the bottleneck.
04
Manage Conflicts Constructively
Handle clashes and performance issues early, fairly, without damaging trust.
05
Keep Teams Motivated Under Pressure
Keep your team energised and focused when deadlines slip and morale dips.
06
Share Feedback Effectively
Give hard feedback without damaging relationships — build a feedback culture.
07
Communicate with Clarity & Impact
Give updates, escalate well, manage up — build credibility with your founder.
08
Effective Hiring — Build Your Team Right
Attract, assess and close the right candidates for your own team.
